commands.help: The commands, or one of them explained
commands.undo: Undo the last change made in this conversation
commands.create-goal: A new goal: an amount in zł is a money goal, in pkt a points goal
commands.deposit-goal: Put money from the balance onto a money goal
commands.goals: The goals and how far they are
commands.edit-goal: Change the name or the amount of a goal
commands.delete-goal: Delete a goal (money put aside goes back to the balance)
commands.add-money: Record an income: amount, category, note, date (a bare 5.10 is the amount; dates: today, yesterday, fri, 12.10.2026)
commands.remove-money: Record an expense (it costs points at the general rate; a bare 5.10 is the amount; dates: today, yesterday, fri, 12.10.2026)
commands.balance: The balance, this month's expenses and money put aside in goals
commands.delete-transaction: Delete a transaction (balance and points come back)
commands.complete-chore: Log a finished chore (today or yesterday)
commands.chores: Chores: done today, to be paid out, entries this month
commands.settle-chores: Settle the payout: chore points go to Money as złoty
commands.log-activity: Log an activity: type, time, note (points with the daily limit)
commands.streak: Streak of days with points and the streak freeze
commands.stats: Points and activity time of the last 7 or 30 days
commands.what-now: What now? Picks an idea for the time given, saves nothing
commands.complete-task: Mark a task done (PC build pieces only when on time)
commands.tasks: Tasks: today and overdue by default, or today, overdue, all
commands.edit-task: Change the text, due date or size of a task
commands.delete-task: Delete a task (the PC build stays as it is)
commands.create-note: A new note: the first word (or the quoted words) is the title, the rest is the content
commands.archive-note: Move a note to the archive
commands.find-note: Search the titles and contents of notes
commands.lang: The app language: pl or en
commands.theme: Theme: lifexp, ios, gold and light, dark, system (stays on this device)
commands.module: Turn a module on or off: chores, money, notes, stats, games
commands.go: Go to a screen: today, tasks, goals, chores, money, notes, stats, reports, settings
